intro: Your plans might start with one room or involve the whole house. I.S Design + Build brings an in-house team and construction experience since 1989 to kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations and additions.

Discuss your renovation

sections.title: Find the right starting point.
blocks: A better kitchen. Reconsider the layout, storage, surfaces and lighting around how you cook and spend time together.
A more useful bathroom. Explore changes to the layout, shower, storage and finishes, with attention to the practical work behind them.
A coordinated renovation. Plan changes across several rooms or floors together, including the systems and finishes that connect them.
More space at home. Explore an addition and how it could connect to the rooms, structure and outdoor space you already have.

sections.title: One room or a bigger plan.
blocks: You do not need a complete design to start a conversation. Describe what is not working, what you would like to keep and what a successful project would change for you. If you already have drawings or inspiration, include those too.

sections.title: Questions worth discussing early.
blocks: What is the property’s current condition? Will the layout change? Which materials and finishes matter most? Do you plan to stay in the home during the work? These decisions help define the scope and the next steps.
Tell us what you have in mind

label: Kitchens
title: Kitchen Remodeling in DC & Nearby | I.S Design + Build
description: Plan a kitchen around how you cook and live. Explore layouts, storage and finishes with our in-house team in DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County.
headline: A kitchen that works for you.
intro: Plan a kitchen around the way you cook, gather and move through the day. I.S Design + Build handles kitchen remodeling in Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, including Bethesda and Chevy Chase.
From a focused update to a more extensive renovation, our in-house team can help you consider the room as a whole.
Tell us about your kitchen

sections.title: Start with how the room works.
blocks: A kitchen can look good and still be difficult to use. Perhaps storage is awkward, the work surfaces are too far apart or the room feels disconnected from the rest of the home. Start with those everyday frustrations. They help shape a useful plan.

sections.title: The details that make the difference.
blocks: Layout and circulation. Consider where you prepare food, cook, clean and sit, and how people move through the room.
Cabinetry and storage. Make space for the items you use most, with choices that fit the room and your priorities.
Surfaces and finishes. Compare appearance, maintenance and everyday use when choosing counters, flooring and other finishes.
Lighting and fixtures. Think about task lighting, the atmosphere of the room, and how appliances and fixtures fit the plan.

sections.title: A kitchen project starts with a clear scope.
blocks: Keeping the existing layout and changing it significantly are different kinds of projects. Plumbing, electrical work, the condition behind existing finishes, and material choices can all affect the work required. We can discuss your priorities before you commit to a particular direction.

sections.title: See actual kitchen work.
blocks: Explore kitchen photographs from our completed projects and the details that brought each space together.
View kitchen projects.

sections.title: Kitchen remodeling questions
blocks:
Do I need a design before contacting you?
No completed design is needed to make an enquiry. Tell us what you want to change and share drawings or inspiration if you have them.

Can I keep the existing layout?
That is one option to explore. A layout that already works may allow the project to focus on cabinetry, surfaces, fixtures and finishes. The condition of the room and proposed work still need review.

What affects the cost?
The room’s size and condition, layout changes, cabinetry, appliances, finishes and associated construction work all matter. A project-specific scope is needed before an accurate estimate can be prepared.

How long will the renovation take?
The scope, approvals where needed, selections, material availability and construction sequence affect the schedule. Share any important dates at the beginning so they can be considered.

sections.title: Let’s talk about your kitchen.
blocks: Tell us what works now, what does not, and what you would like the room to become.
Start a kitchen enquiry

label: Bathrooms
title: Bathroom Remodeling | I.S Design + Build
description: Explore bathroom layouts, showers, storage and finishes with our in-house team. Serving DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, Maryland.
headline: A bathroom that makes everyday life easier.
intro: Better storage. A more comfortable shower. A layout that makes the most of the space. I.S Design + Build remodels bathrooms across Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, including Bethesda and Chevy Chase.
We welcome individual bathroom projects and bathroom work within a larger renovation.
Tell us about your bathroom

sections.title: Make the room work harder.
blocks: Begin with how the bathroom is used and what needs to change. You may want more storage, a different shower or tub arrangement, better lighting, or a layout that feels less cramped. Those priorities should guide the design.

sections.title: Look beyond the finishes.
blocks: Tile, fixtures and surfaces are only part of a bathroom renovation. The condition of the room, plumbing, ventilation and waterproofing also shape the work. Planning these elements together helps define a coherent project.
Layout. Consider the position of fixtures, usable floor space and the way doors open.
Shower and bathing space. Compare arrangements around comfort, cleaning and the needs of the people using the room.
Storage and lighting. Find practical places for everyday items and lighting suited to different tasks.
Finishes. Choose materials with appearance, maintenance and wet-area use in mind.

sections.title: Plan for the home around it.
blocks: If this is the only bathroom in the home, access during construction is an important early discussion. If the work is part of a larger renovation, consider how the sequence fits the rest of the project.

sections.title: Bathroom remodeling questions
blocks:
Can you work on a small bathroom?
Yes. Tell us about the room and what you want to improve. We welcome smaller bathroom projects as well as more extensive renovations.

Can the bathroom layout change?
Potential changes need to be considered alongside the building, plumbing and available space. Share your goals so the options can be reviewed.

Can you consider easier access?
Tell us about the access and comfort needs you want the project to address. Options need to be assessed for the specific property.

Can a bathroom be part of a whole-home renovation?
Yes. Planning the bathroom alongside other rooms can help coordinate the work and the decisions involved.
Start a bathroom enquiry

label: Whole-home renovations
title: Whole-Home Renovations | I.S Design + Build
description: Coordinate layouts, systems and finishes across your home. Discuss a whole-home renovation in DC, Northern Virginia or Montgomery County.
headline: Bring your home together.
intro: When changes reach beyond one room, it helps to consider the home as a whole. I.S Design + Build brings an in-house team to substantial renovations across Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County.
Discuss your home renovation

sections.title: Start with the way you want to live.
blocks: You may need better connections between rooms, a more useful kitchen, updated bathrooms or a broader change to the home’s layout and finishes. Begin with what matters most and where the existing home falls short.

sections.title: Consider the whole project.
blocks: Layout and connections. Review how rooms work together and which changes would make the greatest difference.
The building beneath the finishes. The condition of the structure and existing systems can influence the scope. Assessments should guide decisions before finishes are chosen in isolation.
Materials and details. Coordinate selections across rooms while allowing each space to serve its own purpose.
Construction sequence. Consider the order of work, access, deliveries and any plans to remain in the property.

sections.title: A practical plan for a larger undertaking.
blocks: A whole-home renovation involves connected decisions. Clear priorities make it easier to evaluate options, define the scope and discuss changes when they arise. Share your intended use of the home, any important dates and the areas you are most concerned about.

sections.title: Whole-home renovation questions
blocks:
Does the entire house have to be renovated at once?
Not necessarily. Phasing may be worth exploring, depending on the work, access and the connections between different parts of the project. It needs to be considered against the overall scope.

Can I live at home during the work?
That depends on the areas affected, essential services, access and safety requirements. Discuss occupancy early rather than assuming every project can be completed around normal household use.

What should I bring to the first enquiry?
A description of your priorities, the property location, any existing drawings or photographs, and your preferred timing are useful starting points.
Tell us about the whole picture

label: Home additions
title: Home Additions in the DC Area | I.S Design + Build
description: Explore additional space and how it could connect to your existing home. Discuss a home addition in DC, Northern Virginia or Montgomery County.
headline: More room for the life you have.
intro: Explore what additional space could make possible. I.S Design + Build works on home additions in Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, with attention to how new space connects to the existing home.
Discuss an addition

sections.title: Begin with what the space needs to do.
blocks: A growing household, a different daily routine or a room that no longer meets your needs can start the conversation. Before choosing the shape of an addition, consider what you want it to change about the way the home works.

sections.title: Feasibility comes first.
blocks: The property, existing structure, site access and applicable planning requirements influence what may be possible. Proposed additions need a property-specific review; the size or design that works next door is not automatically right for your home.

sections.title: Make the old and new work together.
blocks: Consider the connection between rooms, changes to circulation, materials, natural light and the relationship with outdoor space. An addition may also involve changes within the existing home, so the scope should account for both.

sections.title: Home addition questions
blocks:
Can you tell me whether an addition is possible from a message?
We can collect the initial details and identify what needs review. Feasibility requires the appropriate property and planning information; an online conversation is not approval to build.

Do additions require permits?
Permit and planning requirements depend on the location and scope. They must be checked for the particular project before work proceeds.

Can an addition include remodeling existing rooms?
Yes. Tell us about both the additional space and the existing rooms you want to change so the overall project can be considered together.
Tell us where you need more room

label: Roofing
title: Roof Repair & Replacement | I.S Design + Build
description: Discuss roof repairs, replacement and associated concerns with I.S Design + Build. Serving Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County.
headline: Take care of the roof over your home.
intro: I.S Design + Build provides roofing repairs and replacement in Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, Maryland. Tell us about the condition of your roof and the problem you want to address.

Tell us about your roof

Or call (202) 519-1831.

sections.title: A repair or replacement starts with understanding the problem.
blocks: A visible leak may be only part of the picture. The condition of the roof, the affected area and any associated damage all matter when deciding what work is appropriate.
Roof repairs. Tell us about leaks, visible wear or a specific area of concern. Photographs taken from a safe location can help explain the issue before the next step is arranged.
Roof replacement. If you are considering replacement, share what you know about the existing roof, its condition and any previous work. Materials and scope need to suit the property.
Associated damage. Let us know if water has affected ceilings, walls or other parts of the home. Include those concerns in the enquiry so the full extent of the requested work is clear.

sections.title: Explain what you are seeing.
blocks: When you contact us, include the property location, whether water is currently entering, where the issue appears inside or outside, and any recent repairs. Do not climb onto the roof to gather information.

sections.title: Roofing questions
blocks:
How do I know whether to repair or replace the roof?
The answer depends on its condition, the type and extent of damage, and the existing roof system. A project-specific assessment is needed before recommending a scope.

Can I send photographs?
You can attach photographs to an email to info@isdesignandbuild.com. Use photographs you already have or can take safely; do not access the roof for this purpose.

Do you offer emergency service?
Call to discuss a time-sensitive issue and confirm availability. The website does not promise emergency attendance or a response time.

What roof materials do you work with?
Tell us what you know about your existing roof, or choose “Not sure” in the enquiry. The team will need to confirm the systems suitable for your project.
Start a roofing enquiry

label: Our process
title: Our Remodeling Process | I.S Design + Build
description: Understand the steps from project enquiry and planning to scope, construction and a final walkthrough with I.S Design + Build.
headline: Know what comes next.
intro: Every property and project is different. A useful starting point is understanding your goals, the existing home and the work you want to undertake.

sections.title: 1. Tell us about the project.
blocks: Email or call us, or prepare an email enquiry through this website. Share the property location, the type of work and what you would like to change. Drawings and photographs can be useful if you have them.

sections.title: 2. Review the home and the possibilities.
blocks: The project needs to be understood in the context of the property. The next steps may include a conversation, a site review and discussion of design options, depending on the scope.

sections.title: 3. Define the scope and estimate.
blocks: Discuss what is included, the relevant selections and any items that need further investigation. Planning and permit requirements, where applicable, also need to be considered.

sections.title: 4. Agree the work before construction.
blocks: Review the proposed scope, costs and project arrangements before work begins. Make important requirements and decisions explicit so the team and customer are working from the same understanding.

sections.title: 5. Build and communicate.
blocks: Construction involves progress, decisions and sometimes discoveries about an existing property. The project arrangements should make clear how updates and proposed changes will be discussed.

sections.title: 6. Walk through the result.
blocks: Review the completed work, discuss any remaining items and understand the relevant next steps for the project.

sections.title: Start with the information you have.
blocks: You do not need every detail decided before making an enquiry. A clear description of your goals is a useful beginning.
Tell us about your project

label: FAQs
title: Remodeling & Roofing Questions | I.S Design + Build
description: Answers about services, project enquiries, service areas and planning a renovation or roofing project with I.S Design + Build.
headline: A few useful answers before you start.
intro: Planning a room, a roof or a larger renovation? Here are a few useful starting points.

sections.title: What services do you offer?
blocks: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, whole-home renovations, home additions and roofing. If your project includes something else, describe it in the enquiry so the scope can be reviewed.

sections.title: Do you take smaller projects?
blocks: Yes. We welcome individual room projects as well as substantial renovations. Tell us what you have in mind.

sections.title: Where do you work?
blocks: Washington, DC, Northern Virginia and Montgomery County, Maryland, including Bethesda and Chevy Chase. Share your town or ZIP code to confirm coverage for the particular project.

sections.title: Do I need drawings before contacting you?
blocks: No. A description of what you want to change is enough to begin an enquiry. Include drawings or photographs if you already have them.

sections.title: Can you give me a price online?
blocks: An accurate project estimate needs an appropriate understanding of the property and scope. You can prepare an email enquiry through this website; it does not provide a binding quote.

sections.title: How do I speak to someone?
blocks: Call (202) 519-1831 or email info@isdesignandbuild.com. You can also prepare an email enquiry through the website.
